summary: Update rebate-rollforward skill with critical anti-patterns discovered in trace: (1) openpyxl SUM formula construction bug where column letter is omitted from range end (e.g., =SUM(B6:8) instead of =SUM(B6:B8)), (2) emphasis on running verify_workbook.py before claiming success, (3) reminder to use csv.DictReader for bridge CSV parsing rather than manual comma counting. These caused the agent's first attempt to produce malformed formulas and delayed verification.
